items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And I got the idea of putting a singer, Dinah Washington... I knew they were friends, see

ctx.x: Don't you think that's right, Foots? An agent... If you're booking like two places a night, and three ...(?)..., even if he okayed it, he didn't know... He's not aware of what the booking is. You might even say, 'Well, okay, here's a couple of hundred dollars extra for you?'

But he still got a thousand dollars for it. But the thing is that the promoter had the three days. He didn't do too good in Boston. He broke even in Boston. And I got the idea of putting a singer, Dinah Washington... I knew they were friends, see, and Dinah Washington really made sense, because she's a girl singer, which didn't have nothin' to do with him being a piano player and a singer -- and he liked Dinah anyway. And Dinah's records were kind of big then. So I got them together. And it worked out all right,…
